text: 中国人民银行：为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年10月26日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展7000亿元MLF操作，期限为1年期
text_en: People's Bank of China: To maintain ample liquidity in the banking system, on October 26, 2026, the People's Bank of China will conduct a 700 billion yuan MLF operation with a 1-year term through fixed-quantity, interest-rate-based bidding with multiple-price allotment
